# Square 1:1 reframe of the motion promo

The silent 16:9 motion promo reframed to a 1080x1080 square for feed posts. The fit strategy keeps the full-width headline and chart, and the cream padding matches the promo's own background.

- Type: Square reframe
- Skill: `magnifito-variants`
- Engine: `reframe`
- Output: 1080x1080, 9.6 s, silent
- Video: [`../videos/f02-reframe-square.mp4`](../videos/f02-reframe-square.mp4)

## Recreate it with Claude Code

Install the plugin (see the repository README), open this folder, and give Claude this prompt:

> Make a 1:1 square version of ../videos/06-motion-graphics.mp4 for an Instagram and LinkedIn feed post. Use the first 9.6 seconds (headline, button, service card and the leads chart). The headline and the chart are wider than a square, so fit the frame rather than crop it, and pad with the Magnifito cream #f0eadf so the bands blend into the background. Output 1080x1080.

## Recreate it by hand

From the repository root, one command renders this example exactly as committed:

```sh
npm run showcase -- f02-reframe-square
```

Or run the steps yourself from `showcase/f02-reframe-square/` (after `npm run build && npm link`):

```sh
ffmpeg -t 9.6 -i ../videos/06-motion-graphics.mp4 -c:v libx264 -crf 16 -preset medium work/source.mp4
mgvideo reframe work/source.mp4 --ratio 1:1 --strategy fit --color '#f0eadf' --out work/square.mp4
```

The finished file is `work/square.mp4`. The config files in this folder are the inputs.
